about: Training changes the dashboard marks on its charts, by the first policy version trained under them. Add an entry whenever training settings, rewards or the schema change. Restarts and resumes from an older checkpoint are marked automatically.

changes.title: Training started
changes.detail: Engaged and explore starts, fights end at 60 s (engaged) and 90 s (explore), learning rate 0.0003, rewards v2.

changes.title: Roam, KL target, longer fights
changes.detail: Smell-guided roam added (checkpoint converted, fresh optimizer). Learning rate adjusted toward KL 0.015 and rose to its 0.003 cap. Fights now end at 120 s and 180 s.

changes.title: Reward update
changes.detail: Damage 1.25, downs 3.75, wipe 8.5. New: +0.05 making a player dodge, +0.01 dodging a hit, +0.02 landing an ability. KL measured on each update's final pass; learning rate capped at 0.001.

changes.title: Moved to PC2
changes.detail: Training continues on the second computer (RTX 4060, 20 workers) from checkpoint 5418.
